breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification is a single unrelated sentence about discretization schemes in fvSchemes. It does not address the turbulenceProperties configuration at all, let alone resolve the inconsistency of having both RAS and LES blocks defined simultaneously. The ground truth requires only the RAS block with kEpsilon, with the LES block removed entirely. The generated text fails to fix or even acknowledge this inconsistency.
